lines.text: Can your team escape in sixty minutes? Eight linked puzzles. Each answer opens the next lock. Ciphers, a number grid, and a logic puzzle. Hint cards keep every team moving. Made for adults and teens. Two to twenty players. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.

Thirty-six funny awards for your Christmas party. Guests nominate. Everyone votes. A host script does the talking for you. Then crown the winners with ready-to-print certificates. For the office, family, or friends night. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
